name: Stability Ball Prone Twist
steps: Lie face down with your waist supported on the ball, your palms on the floor and your legs extended behind you.
Brace your abdomen and keep your upper body steady over your hands.
Turn your pelvis to one side, letting your legs follow as the ball rolls slightly under your waist.
Pull your hips back through center and twist to the opposite side, continuing to alternate sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep both palms pressed firmly into the floor and your shoulders square over your hands.
Control the twist deliberately without letting your hips drop toward the ground.
